Aqui van los modulos recompilados (mk.dll / mk.so, ...) que genera tools/build_recomp.sh
a partir de TUS ROMs, y los ficheros .miss que el programa escribe para la siguiente
generacion. No los compartas: salen de ROMs con derechos de autor. Ver LEEME.txt.

The recompiled modules (mk.dll / mk.so, ...) built by tools/build_recomp.sh from YOUR
ROMs go here, with the .miss files the program writes for the next build. Do not share
them: they come from copyrighted ROMs. See README.txt.
